mechanism: Rifampin is a potent inducer of CYP3A4, which significantly increases the metabolism and clearance of perampanel, reducing its plasma concentrations and anticonvulsant efficacy.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; consider increasing perampanel dose by up to 2-fold or using an alternative antiepileptic drug not subject to CYP3A4 induction; reassess dosing if rifampin is discontinued.
